name: radar-site
description: Public site for Radar — landing page, legal pages and the dashboard.

scripts.//icons: Regenerates the PWA icon set from assets/logo.png. Deliberately NOT wired into `build` the way theme:check is: the generator needs sharp, which it reaches through an explicit path into this node_modules, and a resolution difference on the deploy host would turn a cosmetic staleness check into a failed production build. The icons only change when the logo does.
scripts.//calc: Recompiles the app's Dart calculation layer to JavaScript. Needs the Dart SDK, which is why the OUTPUT is committed — the Vercel build host has no Dart and never runs this. See tool/gen-calc-js.mjs.
scripts.//calc:check: Verifies the committed bundle still matches the Dart it was built from, by hashing the sources rather than recompiling — so it runs anywhere Node runs. Gates the build for the same reason theme:check does: shipping the site with last week's formulas while the app runs this week's is exactly the silent drift both gates exist to prevent.
scripts.//build: theme:check and calc:check gate the build so a deploy can never ship CSS tokens or formulas that no longer match their source — the app and the site would drift apart silently otherwise.
scripts.build: npm run theme:check && npm run calc:check && next build
